map.相变（熔化/汽化）过程吸收或释放的热量。: Heat absorbed or released during a phase change (melting/vaporization).
map.Q = m·L；冰的熔解潜热 3.34×10⁵ J/kg。: Q = m L; the latent heat of fusion of ice is 3.34x10^5 J/kg.
map.1 kg 冰融化需 334 kJ。: Melting 1 kg of ice needs 334 kJ.
map.熔化、汽化、凝固的潜热 Q=mL。: Latent heat of melting, vaporization, solidification Q=mL.
map.制冷、热泵负荷估算。: Load estimation for refrigeration and heat pumps.
map.与显热叠加得总热。: Add with sensible heat for the total heat.
map.L=2.26e6（汽化）：1kg 水沸腾吸 2260 kJ。: L=2.26e6 (vaporization): boiling 1 kg of water absorbs 2260 kJ.
map.相变在恒温进行，潜热不改变温度只改变相态。: Phase change occurs at constant temperature; latent heat changes phase but not temperature.
map.显热 Q=mcΔT 改变温度，潜热改变相态。: Sensible heat Q=mc DeltaT changes temperature; latent heat changes phase.
